sources.snippet: WordDetector model Training, export and demo code for the WordDetector word-detection model. The WordDetectorNN model was originally created by Harald Scheidl and is reimplemented here with some best practices and integrated into Xournal++ HTR according to the ADRs (in particular ADR 006 and ADR 007).
